slowdown.note: Co-sponsor (not her own statement) of H.R. 10538, the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act of 2026, whose Section 8 puts every advanced AI system under a 'mandatory pause' until a new federal AI department is staffed and has issued rules. She was added as a co-sponsor after introduction (not in the bill text's original list); the date she joined was not found.

pause.note: Co-sponsor of H.R. 10538; the bill's mandatory pause on advanced AI lasts only until the federal department issues rules, so it is conditional on safety rules, which the rubric treats as mixed. No statement of her own found.

intl.note: H.R. 10538 Section 15 directs the US to 'pursue international agreements and allied coordination to prevent the development of artificial superintelligence', but does not name China or address coordination on pace with China, so not counted. No statement of her own found.

rsi.note: Co-sponsor of H.R. 10538 (not her own statement). Section 9(a) bans AI systems with 'superintelligence precursor characteristics', which Section 3(6) defines to include 'The capacity to automate or greatly accelerate the process of artificial intelligence research and development' and 'The capacity to independently modify or enhance its own functions.'

record: Co-sponsored H.R. 10538, the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act of 2026 (led by Rep. Greg Casar, introduced 24 September 2026), which bans artificial superintelligence and its precursor capabilities (including automated AI research and self-modification) and puts advanced AI under a mandatory pause until a new federal AI department issues rules; she joined after introduction, date not found.

grade_reason: No statement in her own words about catastrophic AI risk, or substantively about AI at all, was found in six web searches or in her official press releases from January 2025 to October 2026, so there is nothing to grade. Her record does include co-sponsoring the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act in autumn 2026, a strong action on catastrophic risk, so a reviewer may want to grade on that record.
notes: All six required web searches ran this time (an earlier attempt had all searches refused). None found a statement by her about superintelligence, extinction, a pause, China talks or AI safety.
